title: Isigijimi Sesono Esingakaze Sibonwe
intro: Ezinye izindaba ku-Quran zembula ukujula kwenkohlakalo umphakathi wonke ongawela kuyo. Lesi sithunywa sama sodwa, sinxusa abantu abacwile ebubini obungakaze bulandelwe yisizwe ngaphambi kwaso. Naphezu kweminyaka yokuxwayisa, izinhliziyo zahlala zilukhuni, futhi isimemezelo saphezulu safika ngendlela eyesabekayo kakhulu. Ungasibona lesi sithunywa sika-Allah esihle?
clues: Ngathunyelwa njengesixwayiso kubantu abagcwele ukuphambuka okungekho sizwe ngaphambi kwabo esake sakwenza.
Abantu bakithi bangibiza ngokuthi ngingumqambimanga futhi basongela ngokuxosha abalandeli bami kanye nami ezweni.
Izivakashi ezihloniphekile zeza ekhaya lami zifana nezinsizwa ezishayayo, futhi ngazizwa ngikhathazekile kakhulu ngokuphepha kwazo.
Abantu bami bafuna nginikele izivakashi zami kubo, bengazi ukuthi lezi zivakashi ziyizingelosi ezithunywe ngu-Allah.
Umlingani wami wayengakholwa nami futhi wakhetha ukusala nabalahliwe.
Ngasindiswa namadodakazi ami ekuseni, njengoba imvula enkulu yamatshe yayina futhi amadolobha ethu egumbuqelwa.

arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verse: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims. (51:36)
